newsitem.title: UK: BAA climbs ahead of price ruling due today.
newsitem.headline: BAA climbs ahead of price ruling due today.

text.p: Shares in airports operator BAA Plc advanced on Thursday ahead of a scheduled ruling on airline charges by the industry regulator later this morning.
By 0806 GMT, the shares had risen 8-1/2p to 513-1/2p. The pricing review is due to be announced at 0830 GMT.

The Civil Aviation Authority said in July it was proposing that landing and passenger handling charges at BAA's three regulated London airports be pegged at three percentage points below inflation for the next five years.
But the regulator reserved its final decision pending further consultation.
BAA has said it wants to be allowed to increase prices in line with inflation.
